title: Greek Pan-Seared Haddock
description: A flavorful Greek-inspired dish featuring tender haddock, pan-seared to perfection and served with crispy flatbread.

ingredients.name: Flatbread
ingredients.notes: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside

instructions: Season the haddock fillets with Greek seasoning.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the haddock fillets and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the flatbread by baking it in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Serve the haddock on top of the flatbread, garnished with parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
